\section[die Brücke]{die Brücke — a bridge}

\label{lesson:GE-C97-bruecke}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the German for an aeroplane, then the German for a car.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: die Brücke}
\textbf{die Brücke} — \textquotedblleft{}a bridge\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{Brücke} $\leftarrow$ Old High German \emph{brugga} $\leftarrow$ Proto-Germanic \emph{*brugjōn} — inherited, the same word as English \emph{bridge}. (EtymDB 2.1)
\end{cousinweb}
